results.title: ‘I would not say no’: Mike Hussey open to joining Stephen Fleming’s England coaching staff as batting coach
results.description: Stephen Fleming’s move to England could be followed by another familiar face from the CSK setup, with Mike Hussey emerging as a potential addition to the coaching staff. The former Australia batter is open to taking up the batting coach role, which could see him help England prepare for an Ashes series against his former side.

results.title: Ezri Konsa completes £51m move to Arsenal from Aston Villa
results.description: The England international has signed a four-year contract with the Premier League champions with the option of a further year.

results.title: Cancelo joins Barcelona from Al-Hilal on 3-year-deal
results.description: article author: Ali Khaled Author: Fri, 2026-08-21 10:18 DUBAI: Portuguese defender Joao Cancelo has left Al-Hilal to join FC Barcelona on three-year-deal, the La Liga giants’ official social media accounts reported on Thursday evening. The Riyadh club terminated the 32-year-old’s contract, allowing him to join the Catalan club on a free transfer. Al-Hilal loaned Cancelo to Barcelona in January, with the player going on to make 23 appearances and score two goals with three assists.
